subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the context of its meaning in the given sentence.

She felt relieved and __light__ after taking the headache medicine
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"light"** means something that is not heavy; having little weight. (हल्का)

 
 
• **Example: **The feather is so **light** that it floated in the air.
 
 
 
• **"Heavy" **refers to something that has a lot of weight; not light. (भारी)
 
 
• **Example: **The suitcase was too** heavy** for me to carry alone.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'light' **is **'heavy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Extinguish **(बुझाना): To put out a fire or a light.

 
 
• **Example:** The firefighters worked tirelessly to extinguish the blaze.
 
 
 
• **Ignorant **(अज्ञानी): Lacking knowledge or awareness in general.
 
 
• **Example: **He was ignorant of the rules and regulations of the game.
 
 
 
• **Dark** (अंधेरा): Having very little or no light.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was so dark that I couldn't see anything.
